lsp.query: Nun befinden sich die Landwirtschaft und der ländliche Raum ja bekanntlich im Niedergang, wozu die gemeinsame Agrarpolitik entscheidend beigetragen hat, denn sie fördert die Konzentration der Flächen, die Intensivierung der Produktion, die zunehmende vertikale Organisation der landwirtschaftlichen Erzeugung, was zur Verödung und Entvölkerung der ländlichen Regionen führt, wie der Rückgang der Arbeitsplätze und der Betriebe um annähernd 22 % beziehungsweise 20 % seit 1990 beweist.
lsp.judge: Now, as is well known, agriculture and the countryside are in decline, to which the common agricultural policy has contributed decisively, because it promotes the concentration of land, the intensification of production, the increasing vertical organization of agricultural production, which leads to the desertification and depopulation of rural regions, as the decline in jobs and businesses by almost 22% and 20% since 1990 proves.
lsp.proxy: Now, agriculture and the rural area are indeed in decline, to which the common agricultural policy has made a decisive contribution, as it promotes the concentration of land, the intensification of production, the increasing vertical organization of agricultural production, which leads to the desolation and depopulation of rural regions, as evidenced by the decline of jobs and businesses by approximately 22% and 20% respectively since 1990.
lsp.reference: Now, agriculture and the rural area are known to be in decline, to which the common agricultural policy has made a decisive contribution, because it promotes the concentration of areas, the intensification of production, the increasing vertical organization of agricultural production, which leads to the depopulation and depopulation of rural regions, as the decline in jobs and companies by approximately 22% and 20% respectively since 1990 proves.

lsp.query: Was seit der reichlich hysterischen Aufbauschung dieser Krise in den meisten unserer Mitgliedstaaten geschieht, trägt sicher nicht dazu bei, junge Menschen zu motivieren, in der Landwirtschaft zu bleiben und erst recht nicht, im ländlichen Raum ihre Zukunft zu sehen, wo sie, wie es in unserem Bericht so schön steht, eine wichtige soziale Funktion zu erfüllen haben, indem sie sich der Landschaftspflege und -erhaltung widmen und zur Deckung des wirtschaftlichen, sozialen und ökologischen Bedarfs des ländlichen Raums beitragen.
lsp.judge: What is happening in most of our Member States since the rather hysterical build-up of this crisis is certainly not helping to motivate young people to stay in agriculture and even less to see their future in rural areas, where, as our report so beautifully puts it, they have an important social function to fulfil by engaging in landscape management and conservation and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of rural areas.
lsp.proxy: What has been happening since the over-the-top dramatization of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less to seeing their future in rural areas, where, as our report so aptly puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to meeting the economic, social, and ecological needs of rural areas.
lsp.reference: What has been happening since the rather hysterical exaggeration of this crisis in most of our Member States certainly does not motivate young people to stay in agriculture and even less to see their future in rural areas, where, as our report so beautifully says, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape conservation and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of rural areas.

lsp.query: Wir müssen, auch in der Welthandelsorganisation, die Ursprungsbezeichnungen unserer Qualitätsprodukte, u. a. des Weins, verteidigen und sichern, denn unsere Zukunft in der EU und was den Export in Drittländer betrifft, liegt in Produkten hochwertiger Qualität, für die es bei uns, und auch in der Welt, zahlungskräftige und mündige Verbraucher gibt.
lsp.judge: We must, also in the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, because our future in the EU and what concerns exports to third countries lies in products of high quality, for which there are in our country, and also in the world, paying and mature consumers.
lsp.proxy: We must, also within the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our high-quality products, including wine, as our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries depends on products of superior quality, for which there are price-paying and informed consumers both at home and around the world.
lsp.reference: We must, even in the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, because our future in the EU and what concerns exports to third countries lies in products of high quality, for which there are, and also in the world, payment-able and mature consumers.

lsp.query: Ich stimme mit Begeisterung für diesen Bericht, weil er all das beinhaltet und gut formuliert, was richtig und wichtig ist für die Erhaltung und Förderung landwirtschaftlicher Familienbetriebe in Europa, Grundbedingung für die Förderung der ökologischen Landwirtschaft mit hochwertigen, regionaltypischen Erzeugnissen, welche die Verbraucher lernen müssen zu schätzen und gerecht zu bezahlen.
lsp.judge: I am enthusiastically voting for this report because it contains and well formulates all that is right and important for the preservation and promotion of agricultural family farms in Europe, a prerequisite for the promotion of organic farming with high-quality, regionally typical products, which consumers must learn to appreciate and pay fairly.
lsp.proxy: I wholeheartedly agree with this report because it includes and presents in a clear manner all that is right and important for the preservation and promotion of agricultural family businesses in Europe, a fundamental condition for the promotion of ecological agriculture with high-quality, regionally typical products, which consumers must learn to appreciate and fairly pay for.
lsp.reference: I enthusiastically support this report because it contains and formulates correctly and importantly what is right and important for the preservation and promotion of agricultural family businesses in Europe, a prerequisite for the promotion of ecological agriculture with high-quality, regionally typical products, which consumers must learn to appreciate and pay fairly for.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für diesen Bericht über die Gemeinsame Fischereipolitik gestimmt, doch fordere ich das Europäische Parlament, den Rat und die Kommission auf, einen unter Ziffer 20 des Berichts gehörenden, jedoch vergessenen Aspekt stärker im Auge zu haben und zu überwachen, nämlich auf welche Art und Weise bzw. ob überhaupt Rentenbetrag, -höhe und -bedingungen im Fischereisektor, und insbesondere der Rentner im Bereich der handwerklichen Fischerei, kontrolliert werden.
lsp.judge: Mr President, although I voted in favour of this report on the common fisheries policy, I would like to ask Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor a point that was forgotten in point 20 of the report, namely the way in which pension payments, amounts and conditions are controlled in the fisheries sector, and in particular for pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, I have indeed voted in favor of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor a particular aspect mentioned under point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely how, or indeed whether, pension amounts, levels, and conditions are controlled in the fishing sector, and particularly for pensioners in the artisanal fishing industry.
lsp.reference: Mr President, I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor a point under paragraph 20 of the report, which is missing, namely how and whether pensions are controlled in terms of amount, conditions and terms in the fisheries sector, and in particular for pensioners in the artisanal fisheries sector.

lsp.query: Da die Gemeinschaft gemäß der einschlägigen Erklärung in Artikel 5 Absatz 1 des Anhangs IX des Internationalen Seerechtsübereinkommens allein für die Erhaltung und Bewirtschaftung der Fischbestände zuständig und damit befugt ist, die entsprechenden Regeln und Bestimmungen festzulegen, sollte die Kommission von dieser Befugnis Gebrauch machen und das ausschließliche Fangrecht auch für die griechischen Fischer auf 12 Seemeilen festlegen.
lsp.judge: Since the Community is solely responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks under Article 5(1) of Annex IX of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea and is therefore empowered to lay down the relevant rules and regulations, the Commission should exercise this power and set the exclusive fishing right for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles.
lsp.proxy: In accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5, paragraph 1 of Annex IX to the International Convention on the Law of the Sea, the community is responsible and authorized for the conservation and management of fish stocks, and thus entitled to establish the corresponding rules and regulations. The Commission should exercise this authority and also set the exclusive fishing right to 12 nautical miles for Greek fishermen.
lsp.reference: Since the Community is responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks in accordance with the relevant provisions of Article 5(1) of Annex IX to the International Convention for the Conservation of the Living Resources of the High Seas, the Commission should exercise this competence and set the exclusive fishing right also for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles.

lsp.query: Die Kommission führt folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz zwischen den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, insbesondere zwischen Erhaltung der Ressourcen, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Arbeitsplatzsicherung in den von der Fischerei abhängigen Gebieten; stärkere Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension des Fischereisektors; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie insbesondere die Einbeziehung der mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
lsp.judge: The Commission identifies the following priorities: improved coherence between the different objectives pursued by the CFP, in particular between resource conservation, economic viability and job security in fishing-dependent areas; greater consideration of the economic dimension of the fisheries sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improved management instruments, in particular the inclusion of multiannual management objectives; a clearer decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the CFP.
lsp.proxy: The Commission sets the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the GFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, economic viability and job security in the areas dependent on fishing; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, including in particular the inclusion of multi-annual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.
lsp.reference: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the GFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, profitability and job security in the areas dependent on fishing; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, in particular the inclusion of multi-annual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.

lsp.query: Bis zum 31. Dezember 2002 bleiben uns noch zwei Jahre, in denen wir über eine gemeinsame Politik nachdenken und beschließen können. Laut Aufstellung der Europäischen Kommission stellen sich in diesem Zusammenhang 18 Fragen, wie freier oder nicht freier Zugang zu den Gemeinschaftsgewässern, Kontrolle oder Management des Marktes für Fischerei- und Aquakulturerzeugnisse, internationale Fischereiabkommen, wissenschaftliche Forschungstätigkeit in Bezug auf die Fischbestände, Besonderheiten des Mittelmeerraums.
lsp.judge: We have two years left until 31 December 2002, during which we can think and decide on a common policy. According to the European Commission's agenda, 18 questions are raised in this context, such as free or non-free access to Community waters, control or management of the market for fishery and aquaculture products, international fisheries agreements, scientific research on fish stocks, and the special features of the Mediterranean.
lsp.proxy: Until 31 December 2002, we still have two years in which we can think about and decide on a common policy. According to the European Commission's outline, 18 questions arise in this context, such as free or non-free access to community waters, control or management of the market for fishery and aquaculture products, international fishery agreements, scientific research activities regarding fish stocks, and the specificities of the Mediterranean area.
lsp.reference: We have two years left until December 31, 2002, in which we can think and decide on a common policy. In this context, the European Commission lists 18 questions, such as free or not free access to Community waters, control or management of the market for fishery and aquaculture products, international fishery agreements, scientific research activities in relation to fish stocks, particularities of the Mediterranean area.

lsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag zum "Balkan-Syndrom " dient lediglich dazu, die kriminelle Politik der NATO und der Europäischen Union zu bemänteln, die unter dem Vorwand, die Menschenrechte verteidigen zu wollen, in Jugoslawien interveniert haben und dadurch irreparable menschliche und materielle Schäden verursacht haben.
lsp.judge: The joint resolution on the "Balkan syndrome" is intended to cover up the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of defending human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
lsp.proxy: The joint resolution motion on the "Balkan Syndrome" serves merely to whitewash the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
lsp.reference: The joint resolution on the "Balkan Syndrome" is only intended to cover up the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which have intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.

lsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag bestreitet den eindeutigen Zusammenhang zwischen der Verwendung von abgereichertem Uran und dem Auftreten von Krebs und Leukämie bei Soldaten, die an den Besatzungskräften in Bosnien und im Kosovo, aber auch am Golf-Krieg beteiligt gewesen sind. Er beschränkt sich auf den frommen Wunsch nach "einer offenen und transparenten Debatte " sowie nach Einsetzung einer Arbeitsgruppe und fordert "die Mitgliedstaaten, die auch der NATO angehören, auf, ein Moratorium für die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran...vorzuschlagen ", während von der ÍÁÔÏ lediglich verlangt wird, "den Einsatz anderer Munitionstypen in Erwägung zu ziehen ", d. h. sie kann zwar weiterhin töten, aber mit "sauberen " Waffen.
lsp.judge: The joint resolution denies the clear link between the use of depleted uranium and the occurrence of cancer and leukemia in soldiers who have been involved in the occupation forces in Bosnia and Kosovo, but also in the Gulf War. It is limited to the pious wish for "an open and transparent debate" as well as the establishment of a working group and calls on "the member states, which also belong to NATO, to propose a moratorium on the use of ammunition with depleted uranium ...", while the NATO is only required to "consider the use of other types of ammunition", i.e. it can continue to kill, but with "clean" weapons.
lsp.proxy: The joint resolution motion denies an evident link between the use of depleted uranium and the occurrence of cancer and leukemia among soldiers who were involved in the peacekeeping forces in Bosnia and Kosovo, as well as in the Gulf War. It confines itself to the pious wish for "an open and transparent debate" as well as the establishment of a working group and demands "that member states, which also belong to NATO, suggest a moratorium on the use of ammunition with depleted uranium...," while the EU merely requires "to consider the use of other types of ammunition," i.e., it can still kill, but with "clean" weapons.
lsp.reference: The joint resolution denies the clear link between the use of enriched uranium and the occurrence of cancer and leukemia in soldiers who were involved in the occupation forces in Bosnia and Kosovo, but also in the Gulf War. It limits itself to the pious wish for "an open and transparent debate" and the establishment of a working group and calls on "the Member States that are also members of NATO to propose a moratorium on the use of ammunition with enriched uranium...," while the ÍÁÔÏ only requires "to consider the use of other types of ammunition," i.e. it can still kill, but with "clean" weapons.

lsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
lsp.judge: Since the beginning of the nuclear age with World War II, the dangers and precautions that must be taken when handling uranium and other radioactive substances have been well known, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element if inhaled or ingested, which is also genetically dangerous.
lsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and preventive measures are well known that one must observe when handling uranium and other radioactive substances, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.
lsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures are well known that one must observe when dealing with uranium and other radioactive substances, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element if one inhales or takes it in, which is also genetically dangerous.

lsp.query: Angesichts des Ausmaßes des Verbrechens gegen ganze Zivilbevölkerungen ist es dringend notwendig, die Hauptverantwortlichen für diese verbrecherischen Akte gegen die Menschlichkeit zu ermitteln, ihre Schuld festzustellen und sie zu verurteilen sowie die Herstellung, Erprobung, Benutzung und den Verkauf von Waffen mit abgereichertem Uran unverzüglich zu verbieten und nicht nur ein Moratorium anzunehmen.
lsp.judge: In view of the magnitude of the crime against entire civilian populations, it is urgent to identify the main perpetrators of these criminal acts against humanity, to establish their guilt and to condemn them, and to ban the manufacture, testing, use and sale of weapons with depleted uranium, not only to adopt a moratorium.
lsp.proxy: In light of the scale of the crimes committed against entire civilian populations, it is urgently necessary to identify the main perpetrators of these heinous acts against humanity, to establish their guilt, and to condemn them, as well as to immediately prohibit the production, testing, use, and sale of uranium-enriched weapons and to adopt not only a moratorium.
lsp.reference: In view of the magnitude of the crime against entire civilian populations, it is urgently necessary to identify the main perpetrators of these criminal acts against humanity, to establish their guilt and to sentence them, and to immediately prohibit the manufacture, testing, use and sale of weapons with enriched uranium, not only to accept a moratorium.

lsp.query: Wir alle wissen, dass diese Waffen, die von der NATO im Golfkrieg (1991), in Bosnien (1994-95) und im Kosovo (1999) eingesetzt wurden, schwerwiegende Folgen zunächst für die bombardierte Zivilbevölkerung, aber auch für die Umwelt und die Militärangehörigen der NATO, der irakischen, bosnischen, serbischen und kosovarischen Streitkräfte hatten.
lsp.judge: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95) and in Kosovo (1999), had serious consequences first for the bombed civilian population, but also for the environment and the military personnel of NATO, the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian and Kosovar forces.
lsp.proxy: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95) and in Kosovo (1999), had severe consequences initially for the civilian population that was bombed, but also for the environment and the NATO military personnel, as well as the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian, and Kosovo military forces.
lsp.reference: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95) and in Kosovo (1999), had serious consequences first for the civilian population bombed, but also for the environment and the military personnel of NATO, the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian and Kosovo forces.

lsp.query: Abgesehen davon spricht der Entschließungsantrag kurz überaus ernste Fragen im Zusammenhang mit der Analyse und der notwendigen Erforschung von abgereichertem Uran an, geht aber an keiner Stelle auf die fortgesetzten Bemühungen ein, Tatsachen, unabhängige, uns allen bekannte Forschungsarbeiten, ja sogar wissenschaftliche Abhandlungen aus NATO-Ländern zu verschleiern und zu verheimlichen, die die Gefährlichkeit von abgereichertem Uran nachweisen und Vorsorgemaßnahmen nennen, die diese Länder ihren Streitkräften auferlegen.
lsp.judge: Apart from that, the resolution calls for a very serious discussion of the analysis and the necessary research of depleted uranium, but it does not address the continued efforts to conceal and hide facts, independent, well-known research work, even scientific papers from NATO countries that prove the danger of depleted uranium and name the precautions that these countries impose on their armed forces.
lsp.proxy: Apart from that, the resolution proposal briefly addresses extremely serious questions related to the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but it does not address the continued efforts to conceal and cover up facts, independent and well-known research works, yes, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which demonstrate the danger of depleted uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
lsp.reference: Apart from that, the resolution briefly addresses extremely serious questions in connection with the analysis and the necessary research of enriched uranium, but does not go into the continued efforts to conceal facts, independent, well-known research, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which prove the danger of enriched uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.

lsp.query: (EN) Herr Präsident, meine Damen und Herren. Im Namen meines Kollegen, Herrn Patten, der bereits nach Moskau abgereist ist, möchte ich dem Parlament zur heutigen Aussprache gratulieren, weil sie uns eine wertvolle Gelegenheit zum Meinungsaustausch über die bevorstehende Sitzung der UN-Menschenrechtskommission in Genf bietet.
lsp.judge: (EN) Mr President, ladies and gentlemen. On behalf of my colleague, Mr Patten, who has already left for Moscow, I would like to congratulate Parliament on today's debate, because it offers us a valuable opportunity to exchange views on the forthcoming session of the UN Human Rights Commission in Geneva.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen. On behalf of my colleague, Mr. Patten, who has already departed for Moscow, I would like to congratulate the Parliament on today's debate, as it offers us a valuable opportunity for an exchange of views on the upcoming session of the UN Human Rights Commission in Geneva.
lsp.reference: (EN) Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen. In the name of my colleague, Mr. Patten, who has already left for Moscow, I would like to congratulate the Parliament on today's debate, as it offers us a valuable opportunity for an exchange of views on the upcoming session of the UN Human Rights Commission in Geneva.

lsp.query: Aus diesem Grund müssen sich der Rat und die Mitgliedstaaten für die universelle Ratifizierung der wichtigsten Menschenrechtsinstrumente einsetzen, die allen Ländern zur Verfügung stehen. Dazu zählen insbesondere der Internationale Pakt über bürgerliche und politische Rechte, der Internationale Pakt über wirtschaftliche, soziale und kulturelle Rechte, das Übereinkommen zur Beseitigung jeder Form von Diskriminierung der Frau, das bereits erwähnte Übereinkommen über die Rechte des Kindes, das Internationale Übereinkommen zur Beseitigung jeder Form von Rassendiskriminierung und das überaus wichtige Übereinkommen zur Verhütung von Folter und unmenschlicher oder erniedrigender Behandlung oder Strafe.
lsp.judge: For this reason, the Council and the Member States must work for the universal ratification of the most important human rights instruments available to all countries. These include, in particular, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, the aforementioned Convention on the Rights of the Child, the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination and the extremely important Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment.
lsp.proxy: For this reason, the Council and member states must work towards the universal ratification of the most important human rights instruments available to all countries. These include, in particular, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of all Forms of Discrimination against Women, the aforementioned Convention on the Rights of the Child, the International Convention on the Elimination of all Forms of Racial Discrimination, and the extremely important Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment.
lsp.reference: For this reason, the Council and Member States must work for the universal ratification of the most important human rights instruments that are available to all countries. These include, in particular, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, the Convention on the Rights of the Child, which has already been mentioned, the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination and the extremely important Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment.

lsp.query: Wir fordern die EU außerdem auf, die UN-Hochkommissarin für Menschenrechte sowie die anderen internationalen Organisationen und die NRO im Kampf gegen die Unterdrückung unabhängiger Medien - ein Punkt, den Lord Bethell bereits angesprochen hat - sowie von Journalisten und Schriftstellern zu unterstützen und alle Staaten dazu anzuhalten, die Zensur abzuschaffen, das Recht auf Zugang zu offiziellen Informationen zu schützen und die Einschränkungen beim Zugang zur modernen Informationstechnologie aufzuheben, die oft die Rettung für unterdrückte Menschen ist.
lsp.judge: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and the other international organisations and NGOs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point already raised by Lord Bethell - and of journalists and writers, and to urge all states to abolish censorship, protect the right of access to official information and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the lifeline for oppressed people.
lsp.proxy: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and other international organizations and NGOs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point that Lord Bethell has already mentioned - as well as journalists and writers, and to urge all states to abolish censorship, protect the right to access official information, and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the lifeline for oppressed people.
lsp.reference: We also call on the EU to support the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and other international organizations and NGOs in the fight against the suppression of independent media - a point raised by Lord Bethell - and to encourage all states to abolish censorship, protect the right of access to official information and lift restrictions on access to modern information technology, which is often the salvation for oppressed people.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Vitorino, Herr Ratspräsident, wenn wir eine Entscheidung über ein Thema wie die Menschenrechte treffen sollen, haben wir zwei Möglichkeiten: Wir können Prinzipien nennen und auf die Benennung von Gebieten verzichten, oder wir können so vorgehen, wie wir es getan haben, nämlich Gebiete benennen und dabei das Risiko eingehen, dass man einige vergisst.
lsp.judge: Mr President, Mr Vitorino, Mr President-in-Office of the Council, if we are to take a decision on a subject such as human rights, we have two options: we can name principles and refrain from naming areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely name areas and run the risk of forgetting some.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. President of the Council, if we are to make a decision on a topic such as human rights, we have two options: we can name principles and forego the naming of areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely name areas and thereby take the risk that some may be forgotten.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Vitorino, Mr. President, if we are to make a decision on a topic such as human rights, we have two options: we can name principles and forego the naming of areas, or we can proceed as we have done, namely naming areas and thereby run the risk of forgetting some.

lsp.query: In Bezug auf die Entwicklungsländer sind wir daher gezwungen, für die Sanktionen eine besondere Strategie zu entwickeln, so dass nicht nur diejenigen betroffen sind, denen wir eigentlich helfen wollten und die bereits vorher leiden mussten.
lsp.judge: In relation to developing countries, we are therefore forced to develop a special strategy for sanctions so that not only those who we actually wanted to help and who already suffered before are affected.
lsp.proxy: In relation to developing countries, we are therefore forced to develop a special strategy for the sanctions, so that not only those who we actually wanted to help are affected, but also those who have already suffered beforehand.
lsp.reference: Therefore, in the case of developing countries, we are forced to develop a special strategy for sanctions, so that not only those affected are affected, whom we actually wanted to help and who had already suffered before.

lsp.query: Wir sehen mit großer Sorge, dass es, auch durch das Handeln des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats - und Herr Solana, den ich hoch schätze, kümmert sich ja mehr um die Aufgabe des Hohen Vertreters - an der Spitze des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats manche Abschottungen gibt, dass man weder der Kommission noch dem Europäischen Parlament Informationen geben will.
lsp.judge: We are very concerned that, also through the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council - and Mr Solana, whom I hold in high esteem, is more concerned with the task of the High Representative - there are some blockages at the top of the General Secretariat of the Council, that neither the Commission nor the European Parliament is given information.
lsp.proxy: We see with great concern that, even through the actions of the Council Secretariat - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - there are some exclusions at the top of the Council Secretariat, that one does not want to give information to either the Commission or the European Parliament.

lsp.query: Erst auf dieser Grundlage sollte ein Konvent unter Beteiligung von Verfassungsexperten, Europarechtsexperten, Vertretern der nationalen Parlamente, des Europäischen Parlaments, nationaler Regierungen, aber auch der Regierungen der Beitrittsländer und natürlich des Gerichtshofs und der Zivilgesellschaft einberufen und mit der Erstellung eines Vorschlages für einen Katalog beauftragt werden, und zwar etwa bis Frühjahr 2003.

lsp.query: Ich möchte jedoch noch einige weiterführende Fragen stellen: Es geht mir um die de facto existierende politische Union zwischen Weißrussland und Polen sowie die Frage, inwieweit die schwedische Ratspräsidentschaft bereit ist, auch auf Russland Druck auszuüben, das ebenfalls Teil einer politischen Union mit Weißrussland ist. Inwieweit erkennt sie die Folgen für die Demokratie und die Stellung Russlands in der Weltgemeinschaft, die durch die Union mit einem Land erwachsen, das wohl kaum als Demokratie zu bezeichnen ist?
lsp.judge: However, I would like to ask a few more questions: I am concerned about the de facto political union between Belarus and Poland and the question of how willing the Swedish presidency is to put pressure on Russia, which is also part of a political union with Belarus. To what extent does it recognize the consequences for democracy and Russia's position in the world community that arise from the union with a country that is hardly to be described as a democracy?

lsp.query: Ich weise Sie darauf hin, dass die Sicherheit das A und O des Luftverkehrs ist, wobei zu beachten ist, dass diese Sicherheit auf zwei Faktoren beruht: zum einen auf dem technischen Faktor, das heißt den Ausrüstungen, Flugzeugen, Flughäfen, Funknavigations- und Flugleiteinrichtungen usw., und zum anderen auf dem äußerst bedeutsamen menschlichen Faktor, der zwar keinen entscheidenden, aber doch einen sehr hohen Anteil an den Flugzeugunglücken hat.
lsp.judge: I would like to point out that safety is the be-all and end-all of air transport, and that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, that is, the equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although not decisive, has a very high share in the air accidents.

lsp.judge: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is not acceptable that the crucial question of the safety of passengers, namely whether the captains, the crews, are rested enough to be able to carry out their duties, is not regulated.

lsp.query: Schaffen wir Vorschriften, suchen wir nach einem größeren Harmonisierungsgrad, fördern wir Maßnahmen, um den Fußgänger- und Fahrradverkehr vernünftig und sicher zu gestalten, und suchen wir nach Formeln zur Reduzierung des Schwerlastverkehrs, zumindest in den Ortschaften; harmonisieren wir die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen durch einen ambitiösen Rechtsrahmen, wie von der Kommission 1986 vorgeschlagen wurde, indem wir die Mitgliedstaaten aus ihrer Trägheit wecken.
lsp.judge: Let us make regulations, let us seek a greater degree of harmonisation, let us promote measures to make pedestrian and cycle traffic reasonable and safe, and let us seek formulas to reduce heavy traffic, at least in towns; let us harmonise speed limits by an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking up the Member States from their inertia.

lsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
lsp.judge: In my opinion, it is clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated measures, but only by a whole complex of measures, and this includes traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road construction, traffic control systems, increased safety standards of vehicles, stricter controls of compliance with the traffic regulations and also a permanent review of the vehicles that are on the road.
lsp.proxy: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
lsp.judge: Mr President, the older among us have not forgotten the extraordinary, gruesome reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital because the Khmer Rouge, whose leader was trained in the tradition of the French Revolution in the precepts of violence and was filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, resettled two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in the year zero.

ilsp.query: Was die spezielle Frage betrifft, ob der Aspekt der Verfolgung aus sexuellen Gründen einen Asylantrag begründet, so hat die Kommission hierzu bereits eine umfassende Konsultation eingeleitet, und wir hoffen, dass im Laufe dieses Jahres die notwendigen Schlussfolgerungen gezogen werden können, damit dem Rat und dem Parlament dann ein Vorschlag zum subsidiären Schutz vorgelegt werden kann, in den auch solche Umstände Eingang finden.
ilsp.judge: As regards the specific question of whether the aspect of persecution on sexual grounds constitutes a ground for asylum, the Commission has already launched a comprehensive consultation on this issue, and we hope that the necessary conclusions can be drawn by the end of this year, so that a proposal on subsidiary protection can then be submitted to the Council and Parliament, which will also include such circumstances.

ilsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
ilsp.judge: Based on this, the amendment to the existing Regulation proposed by us pursues a twofold objective: on the one hand, it aims at further harmonising the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to the harmonisation of the operating requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is a question of establishing procedures which will enable the Community to deal with the variants and exceptions which the Member States have to apply from time to time for operational reasons.

ilsp.query: Für uns sollte dies Anlass ein, unsere Stimme zu erheben, um diese Machenschaften Russlands gegenüber seinem ehemaligen Vasallen zu verurteilen, und durch konkretes Handeln zur politischen Stabilisierung dieser Region und ihrem ökonomischen Aufschwung beizutragen. Und dann sollten wir, wie in der Entschließung vorgeschlagen, einen Sondergesandten für den Südkaukasus benennen, denn ein Flächenbrand im Südkaukasus würde auch Europa nicht verschonen.
ilsp.judge: For us, this should be an occasion to raise our voice to condemn these machinations of Russia against its former vassal, and to contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic recovery through concrete action. And then, as proposed in the resolution, we should appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, because a fire in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.

ilsp.query: Ich appelliere an den Kommissar, unsere humanitäre Hilfe zur politischen Priorität Nr. 1 zu machen - für die USA und für Russland ist die Kaukasusregion längst Priorität -, weil ich das Gefühl habe, dass die Europäische Union - abgesehen von der Kollegin Schleicher, die eine großartige Arbeit leistet - dabei ist, diese Herausforderung zu verschlafen.
ilsp.judge: I appeal to the Commissioner to make our humanitarian aid a political priority No. 1 - for the USA and for Russia the Caucasus region is long a priority - because I feel that the European Union - apart from my colleague Schleicher, who is doing a great job - is sleeping on this challenge.
ilsp.proxy: I appeal to the Commissioner to make our humanitarian aid a political priority number 1 - for the USA and for Russia, the Caucasus region has long been a priority - because I feel that the European Union - aside from colleague Schleicher, who is doing a great job - is in the process of sleeping through this challenge.
ilsp.reference: I appeal to the Commissioner to make our humanitarian aid our number one political priority - for the US and for Russia, the Caucasus region has long been a priority - because I feel that the European Union - apart from Ms. Schleicher, who is doing a great job - is in danger of sleeping through this challenge.
